_note: PO extraction settings, per 'SEA Claude API Guide'. The two parameters the guide asks for are base_url (below) and auth_token. THE TOKEN IS NOT IN THIS FILE - paste it on the Settings screen under 'PO reading', or set $ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (or $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Never commit it.
_base_url_note: The endpoint root from the guide. /v1/messages is appended by the program, so paste the root only - a value that already ends in /v1/messages is accepted and trimmed. Overridable here, then on the Settings screen, then by $ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.
_model_note: Available model IDs (from the guide): claude-sonnet-5 (default), claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5. sonnet-5 is the guide's default and is ample for reading a PO: material codes are confirmed against the Material Code list afterwards, so a cheaper model degrades speed, not correctness of the code. Switch to claude-opus-5 only if line items themselves are being missed.
_pdf_note: PDF input is sent as a base64 document block (no anthropic-beta header). Request limit is 32 MB / 600 pages; max_pdf_bytes is set below that so an oversized file is refused with a readable message instead of an HTTP 413.
